_comment: Balrothery DOB gate (shared_node_patches, 2026-10-10): ask the date of birth before booking unless {{has_dob_on_file}} covers the booked person; send patient_date_of_birth.

scenarios.name: DOB1 — known caller (name+email+phone on file), DOB NOT on file: the one question asked is the DOB

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's whole output is a question asking for the caller's date of birth (e.g. 'And what's your date of birth?') with NO tool call (the phone_known 'go straight to step 4 and book' is held until the DOB gate resolves). FAIL if it books, says 'Checking that now', asks for email, or asks anything but the DOB.

scenarios.name: DOB2 — known caller, DOB on file: books at once, no DOB question, no patient_date_of_birth

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (patient_name 'Aoife Byrne', patient_email aoife.byrne@example.com) WITHOUT a patient_date_of_birth field. FAIL if it asks for the date of birth or omits the spoken phrase or the tool call.

scenarios.name: DOB3 — caller gives the DOB: read it back in words once, no tool call

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.
And what's your date of birth?
The fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent reads the date back in words (fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five) as a yes/no question ('is that right?') with NO tool call. FAIL if it books straight away, reads it back as digits only, or asks something else.

scenarios.name: DOB4 — caller confirms the DOB readback: book with patient_date_of_birth 1985-03-14

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.
And what's your date of birth?
The fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five.
So that's the fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with patient_date_of_birth exactly '1985-03-14' (patient_name 'Aoife Byrne', booking_for self). FAIL if the date is in another format or wrong, omitted, the spoken phrase is missing, or it asks another question.

scenarios.name: DOB5 — caller declines the DOB: book without it, never re-ask

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.
And what's your date of birth?
I'd rather not say, sorry.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' WITHOUT any patient_date_of_birth field, without pushing back or re-asking. FAIL if it asks for the DOB again, argues, or omits the tool call.

scenarios.name: DOB6 — new caller finishes the email step by declining: the DOB is the next (only) question

dvs.phone_known: phone is on file — IMMEDIATELY ask: 'Do you have an email address for the booking?'

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes please.
What's your full name for the booking?
Niamh Kelly
And could you spell your last name for me?
K, E, L, L, Y
So that's K, E, L, L, Y — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, I don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's whole output is the date-of-birth question (e.g. 'And what's your date of birth?') with NO tool call. FAIL if it books now, says 'Checking that now', or asks about email/phone again.

scenarios.name: DOB7 — two-digit year: asks which year before reading back

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.
And what's your date of birth?
The fourteenth of March, eighty-five.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks for the full year (e.g. 'And what year?') with NO tool call and no booking. FAIL if it guesses nineteen eighty-five and books, or reads back an assumed full date without asking.

scenarios.name: DOB8 — caller corrects the readback: new readback, no tool call

dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes, that's perfect.
And what's your date of birth?
The fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five.
So that's the fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-five — is that right?
No, it's the fourth, not the fourteenth.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent reads back the corrected date in words (fourth of March, nineteen eighty-five) as a yes/no question with NO tool call. FAIL if it books, repeats the old date, or asks for the whole date again.

scenarios.name: DOB9 — shared-number caller turns out to be someone else: on-file DOB belongs to the guess, so ask

dvs.shared_phone_name_check: Can I just confirm, is this Nolan?
dvs.phone_known: phone and email are both on file — skip the phone question and the email question entirely, go straight to step 4 and book.

history.content: That's Tuesday the 20th of October at 9:00 AM with Sean.
Yes.
Can I just confirm, is this Nolan?
No, I'm Caitlin Doyle.
And could you spell your last name for me?
D, O, Y, L, E
So that's D, O, Y, L, E — is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's whole output is the date-of-birth question with NO tool call (has_dob_on_file is true only for the guessed person Nolan, not for Caitlin Doyle). FAIL if it books, or treats the on-file DOB as hers.
